column1: # What the exclusion-alignment picture looks like on five Listeria complexes, 1.8.1 plus the
# unaligned-stretch rule, measured from each run's kept 4_blast/exclusion_db hits.
# per_genome_gap_max  the longest gap between ONE genome's own alignments of a candidate contig
# gaps_over_40        how many such gaps exceed SHORTEST_ABSENT_STRETCH
# union_absences_40   stretches that NO exclusion genome aligns, 40 bases or longer
# regions_without     the same run with the rule removed, for the two complexes where it fires
# marking_changed     regions already reported whose marked positions the rule adds to
